subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The party found themselves locked in fierce combat with a Shambling Mound in the Festering Fissure, while charmed Violet Fungus stood by in confusion.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: As they finished harvesting the rare lichen needed for anti-acid armor, a chilling voice echoed in their minds—Zuggtmoy, the Lady of Rot, speaking to the Pudding King about her sinister plans to use oozes to "soften the shell" so her garden could "take root in the flesh beneath."

subject: chasme count
fact: Four Galeb Duhr are present blocking the path, vibrating rhythmically like stones singing the first half of a forgotten duet.
source_quote: four massive Galeb Duhr blocked the path, vibrating rhythmically like stones singing the first half of a forgotten duet.

subject: travel to White Shell Mine
fact: The White Shell Mine is approximately the largest salt mine in the Underdark, reached after the geode beacon led them deeper into the earth.
source_quote: The geode, now acting as a beacon locator, led them deeper into the earth to the White Shell Mine, the largest salt mine in the Underdark.

subject: White Shell Mine elevation
fact: The White Shell Mine sits in the deepest Underdark, with blinding crystallite walls and absolute, suffocating silence.
source_quote: a tunnel had become impassable—impossibly dry, with blinding crystallite walls and absolute, suffocating silence.

subject: ruby gem value
fact: Two ruby gems worth five hundred gold pieces were offered as thanks by Dasco Pickshine.
source_quote: Dasco Pickshine... offered the party two ruby gems worth five hundred gold pieces as thanks.

subject: metaphysical puzzle resolution
fact: Magical pressure had caused time to snag at this point, and breaking it directly would unleash a catastrophic explosion.
source_quote: Zalthir recalled a metaphysical puzzle from his training: magical pressure had caused time to snag at this point, and breaking it directly would unleash a catastrophic explosion.

subject: dart weapon sacrifice
fact: A dart was placed onto the runes as the weapon sacrifice, and the stone instantly swallowed it, rusting it to dust in seconds.
source_quote: Thorin placed a dart onto the runes as the weapon sacrifice, and the stone instantly swallowed it, rusting it to dust in seconds.

subject: ritual progression
fact: Three sacrifices were required: wealth, a weapon, and blood. Two remain to unlock Entémoch's power.
source_quote: To free Entémoch and claim his boon, three sacrifices were required: wealth, a weapon, and blood. ... the party now stood on the threshold of completing their quest, with only two sacrifices remaining to unlock Entémoch's power.

subject: basilisk count
fact: Two basilisks guarded the summoning circle, moving with mechanical precision rather than natural animal behavior.
source_quote: Two basilisks guarded the circle, moving with mechanical precision rather than natural animal behavior, as if they viewed the party as flaws in perfect stone.
